title: A Gift for Mom
text:
Ali goes to the shop on Friday. He wants a gift for his mother. The shop has many bags and hats. He likes a blue bag, but it is expensive.

The shop man is kind. He shows Ali a small green bag. The green bag costs ten lira. Ali is happy and buys it for his mother.

questions.text: What does Ali want to buy?
How much does the green bag cost?
How does the shop man probably feel about Ali?

options: He is careful with his money.

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things

paragraph_translations: Ali cuma günü dükkana gider. Annesi için bir hediye istiyor. Dükkanda çok fazla çanta ve şapka var. Mavi bir çantayı beğeniyor, ama o pahalı.
Dükkan adamı nazik. Ali'ye küçük yeşil bir çanta gösteriyor. Yeşil çanta on lira. Ali mutlu oluyor ve onu annesi için satın alıyor.
